subject: GreenLabs vendor setup: pay rails, PO labels, and micro-deposit verification
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@greenlabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenLabs vendor setup: pay rails, PO labels, and micro-deposit verification

Hi Elena —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for payments routing. To finish vendor onboarding so Finance can issue the first PO and schedule payouts, can you please provide the following by EOD Monday?

1) Completed vendor packet (attached template) or your equivalent compliance packet.
2) W-9 (or local tax form) for GreenLabs, Inc.
3) Bank transfer details in CSV form (bank name, account number, routing/ACH or IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, account holder name, remittance string preference).
4) Preferred PO/Invoice label format so we can map invoice lines to our PO fields (example: PO12345|INV-2028-001).

Quick note on remittance: our AR system expects a single-line structured remittance field up to 128 chars. If you can include a one-line example, Finance will validate.

I attached the standard vendor packet to this thread. If you prefer a DocuSign flow, we can send that instead.

Next steps: once we receive bank proof and W-9, our PayOps team will send two micro-deposits for account verification (typical arrival 1–2 business days). After you confirm the micro-deposit values, we’ll flip the vendor status to "Active" and issue the initial PO.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Onboarding (Procurement)
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments referenced: Vendor_Packet_Redwood.pdf (template)

Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the CSV Elena sent. A couple of finance items before we mark Active and issue PO-55678:

- Remittance mapping: we need the vendor ID to be machine-parseable (no pipes). Can GreenLabs confirm a pipe-free example? e.g. GLV-2094 INV2028001 PO55678
- For wire vs ACH fallback: Finance prefers that the CSV indicate a fallback routing tag. Elena, can you add a column labeled "fallback_method" with either "wire" or "ach"?
- Micro-deposit ETA: once Sofia triggers verification, we expect deposits in 1–2 business days. Please confirm when you see them and reply with exact cents.

If those three small items are OK, we’ll flip the status and schedule the first payment date for 2028-09-28 (net 10 from PO issuance).

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

- Micro-deposits: we received two deposits this morning from Redwood (0.12 USD and 0.37 USD). We confirm these values match what posted to our account.

Per your schedule, once we see the PO issued and the vendor status set to Active on your side, we will accept the 2028-09-28 payout date. Please send the PO number back in reply when it's created so we can match the incoming remittance.

Thanks —
